scope: Three V16 frozen alighted waiting roots. Keep graph, ordered trip model, deadline, actual physical readiness, public information and publisher fixed. No fresh real dates.
paired_decomposition: Replay the exact V16 holdout and precision random streams. Force the actual first ride, then use full clairvoyant tail. Independently minimize over first connections in the issued V16 menu and then use the same clairvoyant tail. Differences C-H_first, H_first-H_menu, H_menu-H_full are pathwise tail, same-menu choice, and outside-menu point differences. They do not estimate causal regret or an implementable gain.
outside_menu_diagnosis: Find a full clairvoyant path witness when H_menu>H_full and inspect the missing first connection's scheduled and realized departure. These are retrospective witnesses, never candidate policy input.
support_pair: Keep every original V16 path, the full conditional scoring, the A/B waiting proxy and 120s margin. Add schedule-early first connections by frozen fitted-law operating mass within MCT readiness plus 720s (minimum .01, up to 12 additions), choose a nominal suffix from public model only. Compare against original V16 on 128 fresh worlds/root at [20261117,int(date),query,decision,2]. Charge all screening and table building. No data-dependent retune.
wait_comparison: Follow-up diagnostic chosen after the support failure. At the July 27 decision 1 root, draw 256 fresh fitted worlds at [20261117,20230727,0,1,3] under the existing chain exactly conditioned on 9488 operating at 29417. Compare whole support and original V16 policies on the public decision class that boards 9488 at that clock against the same A/B proxy. Do not select by the resulting loss or arrival status.
through_control: Independent tape [20261117,int(date),query,decision,1], 128 worlds/root. Screen all V16 extra candidates, then retain only one-trip through paths by trip identity. Compare original first_visible, V16, through-only conditional integration, and through-only conditional operating clock means. Common original A/B waiting reference, 120s margin, physical event publisher and deadline.
actual_seconds: Audit measured timely candidates for exact grid support. Compare bounded public scoring at off-grid observed clocks without rounding the physical departure or transfer. Keep absent source rows unresolved. Actual-source receipts are not independent confirmation.
